snippet.title: District Null - Official Trailer | Cyberpunk City Builder
snippet.description:
District Null is a cyberpunk city builder on the colony planet AZ884. Release: October 30, 2026.

The year is 2438. The Colonial Authority is ready to settle AZ884, a planet almost twice the size of Earth and packed with resources: kryptonite in open crystal fields, glowing spice in a blue lava river, pig iron in cliffs kilometres high. But the north lies under a toxic blanket of smog. On the General's orders you dive through the clouds with Bit, your little support robot, and build a new district out of nothing.

What awaits you:
• Lay roads, zone residential, commercial and industrial areas and watch your city grow house by house
• Real construction times, all the way up to plateaus and skyscrapers
• Living traffic with commuters, traffic lights and highway interchanges
• A power grid with fusion plants, thermal plants and energy relays
• Fire services, ambulances and police on duty
• Cinema, stadium, casino and concert hall, each with its own programme and visitors
• Research lab and university for new technology and skilled workers
• Giant worms, pterosaurs and slime men attack your city: defend it with your own units and ships
• Mine kryptonite, spice and pig iron, fight the smog and earn command of the giant drill project

Website: https://district-null.bitmeup.com/
Discord: https://discord.gg/9AmGw3X3Qk

#DistrictNull #CityBuilder #Cyberpunk
